reasoning: Read AtomVecKokkos_PackBorderVel::operator() (src/KOKKOS/atom_vec_kokkos.cpp ~1828-1905). CPU original src/atom_vec.cpp:951-959 has the else that writes v[j][0..2] unshifted. The KOKKOS buffer row has fixed stride 'elements = size_border + size_velocity', so the shortfall does not spill into the next atom, but every field packed after v inside the same row (angmom, molecule, q, mu, sp, radius, rmass, omega, DPD) is written 3 slots too early, while AtomVecKokkos_UnpackBorderVel unconditionally reads 3 velocity slots and then the remaining fields at the nominal offsets. The DEFORM_VREMAP=1 functor is instantiated only when pbc_flag!=0 && deform_vremap, i.e. exactly 'fix deform ... remap v' with comm_modify vel yes, so the path is reachable.
